title: Roadmap: audit every action, without logging payloads
goal: Record the telemetry requirement as vectors a swarm can execute, after checking what already exists: SusiAuditLogger with an HMAC key, daily-rotated JSON logs, a receipt archive, a capability audit and a signature-verified quorum ledger. What is missing is coverage, correlation, policy and verification - not another log file. The design is two tiers: an audit tier that records every state-changing action (actor, kind, target, outcome, duration, cost, correlation) through one choke point with an exhaustive action enum so coverage is checkable, and a trace tier that is levelled, opt-in, rotated and TTL'd under a measured budget. Payloads never enter the audit tier, retention prunes, the chain verifies, and the history is interrogable.
